reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 18. Nay or No: 9. Not Voting: 12. Present or other: 1. Happy #VeteransDay 2026 to the brave men and women who honorably and selflessly served the United States in uniform. Our nation is forever indebted for the sacrifices you made in pursuit and protection of Liberty. May we thank and honor our veterans today and every day. https://t.co/OXiVv4DpC3

Veterans interred at Arlington deserve respect, and for their final resting places to be treated with dignity. This Veteran's Day, I rose to object to poorly conceived plans for a triumphal arch that would cast a shadow over the sacred grounds of Arlington National Cemetery. https://t.co/wqzmMJns77

Wishing a Happy 251st Birthday to the @USMC! Thank you to all our Marine veterans and those serving around the globe. Your service for the cause of Liberty is unparalleled. #SemperFi https://t.co/WmZlKgQHEW

When I first arrived to Congress, there were only 24 women. Today, there are over 150 women serving across the House and Senate. I look forward to serving with this record breaking number of women who will serve in the 120th Congress in our @DemWomenCaucus. https://t.co/JbFEnx4FW2

Wishing a #HappyDiwali to all celebrating across NW Ohio, across America, and around the globe! I hope this Festival of Lights brings joy to your families and our communities taking part in the festivities. https://t.co/43JJvr5kab

The news of the tragic, unprovoked mass shooting in the heart of historic Krakow is devastating. I join the people of Poland in mourning this senseless act of cowardice. The US-Congressional Poland Caucus along with people in my Great Lakes region in the United States stand in Solidarity with our dear friends—the people of Poland. We pray for the victims, their families, and the entire Krakow community.
Read more here: https://t.co/RBtLUhsb85

The American people said loud and clear—the tired, unfocused, and unbalanced ad hoc economic policies of the Trump Administration don’t work. Ready to roll up my sleeves and get to work investing in infrastructure, addressing affordability, and finding ways to make life in NW Ohio better.
It’s an honor to represent NW Ohioans in Congress every day. I look forward to continuing our work together and to serve alongside the largest delegation of women in history! https://t.co/lYxKxXz2CX

Happy Halloween to all celebrating across NW Ohio! I hope you get your fill of candy, your night is safe, you get more treats than tricks, and that if you run into a bucket like this, you limit it to 1 (one) pieorgi per trick-or-treater. https://t.co/WcmXSP5lsk

This Domestic Violence Awareness Month, I stand with survivors and will always push to hold abusers accountable. If you feel unsafe, please know that help is available. Call the National Domestic Violence Hotline at 1-800-799-7233 or visit the Ohio Domestic Violence Network https://t.co/Cf4IffT8iQ

From groceries, to heating oil, prices are on the rise and hardworking Americans are bearing the cost. These are not economic wins—they are the result of an Administration putting you last.

Wishing a Happy #NationalFarmersDay to all the farmers, growers, producers, ranchers, and cattlemen who make and grow what makes and grows America. As a member of the House Appropriations Agriculture Subcommittee I fight every day to ensure our family farmers will continue to set our tables for generations to come.

The Federal Reserve found prices for consumer goods would have decreased 0.9% in 2025, but instead they increased 2.9% due to the President’s reckless across the board tariffs. This tariff regime is responsible for our affordability crisis.

Our office is now accepting applications for Winter/Spring 2027 internships in our Washington, DC office. We invite hardworking individuals with a passion for public service to apply by October 23rd at noon. More information on the flier below—call 202-225-4146 if you have any additional questions.

Great to join @RailPassengers Association President Jim Matthews, @AllAboardOhio, and train enthusiasts from across America for a fireside chat at their annual conference held this weekend. Passenger rail service across Northern Ohio will benefit our people. https://t.co/3EWeogPuqc

Greeted runners this morning ahead of East Toledo Family Center’s Nickel Dash—thanks to all who came out to support a great cause!

I presented ETFC with an entry in the Congressional Record marking 125 years of faithful service in our community, and immeasurable impact on generations of Toledoans.

Great night under the Friday night lights as Clay took on Anthony Wayne at home in Oregon. Thanks to all who came out to support both teams, and honor our first responders, active duty service members, and veterans. It’s Fall in NW Ohio! https://t.co/UYGucBgf5D
